attention_probabilities.note: softmax probabilities are non-negative; signed 10-bit code

reference.note: logits/class bit-identical to the canonical core; checks add metadata only

title: Single-pipeline checked projection + per-row checksum (no injection hardware)

outputs.pred_class: AXI-Lite register: FPGA argmax, lowest index on ties; class map 0 normal, 1 imbalance, 2 misalignment, 3 bearing_fault
outputs.integrity_status: integrity_status (AXI-Lite, metadata, never a class): bit0 input-buffer XOR signature (after ingress vs after projection), bit1 classifier tail evaluated twice and compared (time-multiplexed on ONE compute unit: detects transient upsets of one evaluation, not persistent/common-mode faults), bit2 projection accumulator outside its proven bound |acc+b| <= 719,316; bit3 per-row projection checksum (ABFT): sum_o acc[r][o] == sum_i x[r][i]*WSUM[i], exact integers

source.build: powershell -File tools/build_raw_core.ps1 -Variant b04; vivado -mode batch -source tools/vivado/rerun_impl_strategy.tcl -tclargs tmp/vb04/vb04.xpr Performance_ExplorePostRoutePhysOpt

timing: default implementation WNS -0.737 ns (failed, kept in artifacts/research/B04_20261114/b04_build_first_impl_timing_fail); Performance_ExplorePostRoutePhysOpt: WNS +0.024 ns

input.representation: raw 24-bit ADC codes, one per little-endian int32 word; 8192 words per window, row-major [sample, channel] (word = sample*8 + channel), TLAST on word 8191
input.on_fpga_preprocessing: per-window per-channel integer z-score -> INT10 codes (+-511) -> 4:1 non-overlapping mean aggregation (1024 -> 256 tokens) inside transformer_top

golden.format: golden_in.txt: header 'count 1024 8', then one window of raw24 codes per line
